description_en: Modifies the privileges of an account in a PolarDB on ENS cluster
description_zh: 修改PolarDB边缘集群的账号权限
kebab_example: aliyun polardb grant-account-privilege-zonal --db-cluster-id 'pc-****************' --account-name testacc --db-name testdb_1,testdb_2 --account-privilege ReadWrite,ReadOnly --region cn-hangzhou
name: GrantAccountPrivilegeZonal

parameters.help_en: The ID of the PolarDB on ENS cluster. This operation applies only to edge clusters. For standard PolarDB clusters, use GrantAccountPrivilege. You can create an edge cluster by calling CreateDBCluster and setting CloudProvider to ENS and specifying EnsRegionId
parameters.help_zh: ENS 边缘集群 ID，本接口仅适用于边缘集群；标准 PolarDB 集群请使用 GrantAccountPrivilege。可通过 CreateDBCluster 指定 CloudProvider=ENS 和 EnsRegionId 创建边缘集群
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the database to which privileges are granted. You can grant privileges to one or more databases at a time. Separate multiple database names with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 需要授权的数据库名称。支持同时对一个或多个数据库授权，多个数据库名称之间用英文逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: db_name

parameters.help_en:
The privileges of the account. Valid values:
ReadWrite: read and write
ReadOnly: read-only
DMLOnly: DML only
DDLOnly: DDL only
ReadIndex: read-only and index
parameters.help_zh:
账号权限，取值范围如下：

ReadWrite：读写
ReadOnly：只读
DMLOnly：只允许 DML
DDLOnly：只允许 DDL
ReadIndex：只读+索引
parameters.name: account_privilege

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must ensure that the token is unique among different requests. The token is case-sensitive and up to 64 ASCII characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 该参数用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，保证在不同请求间该参数值的唯一性。该参数区分大小写、长度不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token
